audience: businesses and support teams who run their phone system on Placetel

useCases.title: Find the calls you missed on a day
useCases.text: The AI lists incoming calls of one day (accepted, missed, blocked, voicemail) with caller number, called number, duration and voicemail file URL.

useCases.title: Review call detail records for a day
useCases.text: The AI reads the call detail records: who called whom, the answering SIP user, length in seconds and cost.

useCases.title: Check how numbers are routed, or switch a profile
useCases.text: The AI reads which routing answers each number, such as ring groups, IVR or queue, and switches a number's active profile, for example to Holiday.

useCases.title: Check call center queues and agents
useCases.text: The AI lists queues and agents, and reads the call-center calls of one day with queue, agent, answer status and time spent in queue.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a phone-book contact
useCases.text: The AI finds shared contacts by name, company, email or number, creates a contact, or updates fields, tags or the blocked flag.

useCases.title: Start a call or send an SMS
useCases.text: The AI starts a real call that rings a SIP user first and then dials the target, or sends an SMS. Both cost money and cannot be undone.
